answer: Practically, the chain should attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because wander only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, meadow is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any ridge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
